_comment: Each rule is checked line by line against Java code blocks in Markdown. A rule fires as an error when the target WPILib year >= removed_in, as a warning when >= deprecated_in. 'source' points at the WPILib yearly changelog (docs.wpilib.org, 'New for YEAR'). 'unverified' means no official source was found yet.

rules.message: Old command-based framework (edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.command) is no longer included in WPILib.
rules.fix: Use the current framework in edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.
rules.source: New for 2023: 'The 2023 release no longer includes the old command-based framework.'

rules.message: Old Button/Trigger binding method was removed.
rules.fix: Use onTrue / onFalse / whileTrue / whileFalse / toggleOnTrue.
rules.source: New for 2023 (renamed, Button deprecated); New for 2024 Breaking Changes (Button and old-style Trigger functions removed).
New for 2025: 'Breaking: Remove deprecated CommandBase'.

rules.fix: Use the static factories in Commands (sequence, parallel, ...).
rules.source: New for 2023 (deprecated); New for 2024 Breaking Changes (removed).
New for 2023 (deprecated); New for 2024 Breaking Changes (removed).
New for 2023 (renamed to until); New for 2024 Breaking Changes (removed).
New for 2025: 'Rename deadlineWith to deadlineFor'.

rules.message: PID/TrapezoidProfile command and subsystem wrappers are deprecated (removed in 2027).
rules.fix: Use PIDController / ProfiledPIDController / TrapezoidProfile directly in your commands or subsystems.
rules.source: New for 2025 (deprecated); 2027 removed-features page.

rules.fix: Use motor controller following (PWMMotorController.addFollower() or the vendor's follow method).
rules.source: New for 2023: 'Removed deprecated SpeedController and SpeedControllerGroup classes'.

rules.message: The SpeedController interface was removed (renamed to MotorController).
rules.source: New for 2022 (renamed); New for 2023 (removed).

rules.fix: Use motor controller following (PWMMotorController.addFollower() or the vendor's follow method).
rules.source: New for 2024 (deprecated); 2027 changelog: 'Remove deprecated MotorControllerGroup'.

rules.message: The old RobotDrive class was removed.
rules.fix: Use DifferentialDrive or MecanumDrive in edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.drive.
rules.source: New for 2022: 'Deprecated RobotDrive has been removed'.
New for 2022: 'IterativeRobot has been removed'.

rules.message: SampleRobot is an old robot base class and is not in current templates.
rules.source: unverified

rules.fix: Use the side-specific methods, e.g. getLeftX(), getLeftTriggerAxis().
rules.source: New for 2022: 'controller.getX(GenericHID.Hand.kLeft) -> controller.getLeftX()'.
New for 2022: 'Timer.hasPeriodPassed() have been deprecated'.

rules.message: The Gyro / Accelerometer interfaces were removed.
rules.fix: Use the concrete gyro or accelerometer class directly.
rules.source: New for 2024 (deprecated); New for 2025: 'Breaking: Remove deprecated Gyro and Accelerometer interface'.
New for 2025: 'Deprecate RamseteController. Use LTVUnicycleController instead'.

rules.message: Math packages moved out of edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.
rules.source: New for 2022, Package Renames: 'Several packages moved from wpilibj to math'.

rules.message: Units is now in the math package.
rules.source: unverified

rules.message: Motor controller classes moved to the motorcontrol package.
rules.source: New for 2022, Package Renames: 'Motor controllers ... have been moved to a motorcontrol package'.
New for 2022: 'Sendable has been broken up ... non-NetworkTables components (moved to wpiutil)'.
New for 2022, Package Renames: 'wpiutil is now util'.
